[/s]A seasonal medieval retexture of Wabiii's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12430]Daphne's Buildable Ice Cream Truck[/url]﻿ mod.

This retexture replaces the default pink colored truck.

The ice cream truck can be purchased from Robin and be built anywhere on the farm.
The shop is open between 9:00am-6:00pm every day, but is closed during the Winter (The truck and Daphne will still be visible c:).
There are random ice creams available each day.

[size=3]🍨🍧🍨🍧🍨[/size]

[b][u][color=#ea9999]The original Daphne's Buildable Ice Cream Truck mod is still required[/color][/u][/b] for this mod to work, so make sure you download it!
[i](and all other mods required by the original!)[/i]

The exterior was created using assets from Gwen's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town.
[/url]﻿﻿
Currently, it is only available in one color option.
I have plans to create multiple recolor options in the future so that it can match everyone's theme perfectly.
